summary: Add selector version breakdown panel + kernel-choice heatmap to standard Runtime Performance dashboard
description:
Request
Add two panels to the standard "Runtime Performance" dashboard used by Runtime + SRE during selector v2 rollout monitoring:

1) Selector version breakdown (v1 vs v2)
- Purpose: confirm % traffic using selector v2 by region and over time; spot accidental reverts/partial deploys.
- Suggested visualization: stacked area (or stacked bar) by selector_version.
- Primary dimensions (must be low cardinality):
  - selector_version: v1|v2|unknown
  - region: us-east|us-west|eu-west|ap-sg (whatever matches existing dashboard bucketing)
  - deployment_mode: hosted|dedicated|private (optional; if available in existing standard tags)
- Metrics to use: kernel selection decision counter (or request counter annotated with selector_version).

2) Kernel-choice heatmap (kernel_id bucketed) by GPU SKU
- Purpose: detect unexpected kernel churn after registry updates and quickly correlate regressions to kernel_id+gpu_sku combinations (especially during canary).
- Suggested visualization: heatmap or table
  - rows: gpu_sku_bucket (L4, A10, A100, H100, other)
  - columns: kernel_id_bucket (top-N + other), or alternatively show top kernels per GPU as a bar chart with % share.
  - value: % of selection decisions (or QPS) for that (gpu_sku_bucket, kernel_id_bucket) within a time window.

Constraints / notes
- Cardinality control is critical. Do NOT break down by raw model_name, raw kernel_id, or request_id.
- Use the standards from the kernel selection telemetry doc (bucketed labels only; sampling is OK).
- We need this to be usable during staged rollout (internal canary -> 5% hosted -> 25% hosted), so it should have region filters and a stable query.

Acceptance criteria
- Panels appear on the standard Runtime Performance dashboard (same one referenced in the release checklist).
- Panels load in <5s at 24h and 7d time ranges.
- Queries use bucketed labels only (no high-cardinality dimensions).
- Panel links added to the selector v2 rollout checklist (Release Eng / SRE).

Background
We had a canary regression investigation where we could not quickly answer:
- "Are we actually on v2 for this cohort/region?"
- "Did kernel choice distribution shift on A10 long-context traffic?"
comments:
2026-02-11 (Aisha Bello): Acknowledged. Will add to the shared Runtime Performance dashboard. Need to confirm the canonical metric name post-PR 18493/18519 and which tag is the normalized GPU SKU.

2026-02-12 (Thomas Baird): Please ensure the heatmap uses kernel_id_bucket (top10 + other) and gpu_sku_bucket from normalization, not raw device_name. Avoid model_family unless it’s already bucketed; if needed, use model_family (llama|mistral|qwen|other) only.

2026-02-13 (Logan Wright): Metric names in prod: redwood_runtime_kernel_selection_total{selector_version=..., gpu_sku_bucket=..., kernel_id_bucket=..., seq_bucket=..., region=...}. seq_bucket is low-cardinality; OK to include as an optional dashboard filter but not default breakdown.

2026-02-14 (Allison Grant): +1 to making seq_bucket a filter. Default view should stay simple: selector_version % by region + kernel distribution by gpu. Add a note pointing to the debugging playbook for deeper drill-down.

2026-02-18 (Aisha Bello): Implemented panels + added dashboard variables: region, selector_version, gpu_sku_bucket, seq_bucket. Heatmap defaults to last 1h and displays % share (sum by gpu/kernel). Also added annotation for runtime deploy events to help correlate shifts.

2026-02-19 (Connor O'Brien): Confirmed panels are visible and linked from the rollout checklist. Closing.
resolution: Done. Added (1) selector_version breakdown panel (stacked time series) and (2) kernel-choice heatmap by gpu_sku_bucket x kernel_id_bucket to the standard Runtime Performance dashboard. Queries use redwood_runtime_kernel_selection_total with bucketed labels only. Added dashboard link to rollout checklist and verified load time at 24h/7d ranges.
